protocol.timing: HIP events; three counter-rotated samples after one warmup
protocol.candidate_boundary: inclusive BF16 cache widen + query transpose + packed strided-batch F32 QK + wave-row causal softmax + packed F32 PV + output transpose
protocol.algorithm_screen: one pass over all 32 zero-workspace QK heuristics, then one pass over all 32 PV heuristics at 4K/16K/64K/128K

untuned_attribution.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 rocprofv3 --kernel-trace --output-directory /tmp/laguna-lc1-long-hipblaslt-trace.ngoky6 --output-format csv --output-file lc1blas -- env PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_attention_long_context_hipblaslt_ceiling.py --samples 1 --warmups 0 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --allow-dirty --output /tmp/laguna-lc1-long-hipblaslt-traced.json
untuned_attribution.assessment: Algorithm 0 made QK the false ceiling. Screening the zero-workspace heuristics is required before judging the library formulation.

decision.result: retain as the LC-1 arithmetic ceiling and integrate a global-only long-context production candidate
decision.reason: The tuned inclusive route is positive at every tested shape and remains 1.250x faster at 128K. It proves tensorized/library QK and PV can beat scalar qrow6, while also showing that bounded score scratch and algorithm selection are material constraints.
decision.next_gate: Route only dense-initial global M128 chunks above 512 through a capacity-sized 48-head long-context owner; then run 4K/16K/64K directional and mandatory 128K complete-model gates.
